title: MCP tools
description: The 20 tools of the Matchbox MCP, generated from the schemas it serves.

title: Address activity
description: What an address or entity did over a period: reward claims (liquid and compounded into locks), lock deposits (own or funding someone else's), swaps, bridge transfers, MUSD minted (borrowed), transfers by counterparty (labelled), and how its locks voted in the latest epochs

title: Claim collateral surplus
description: Prepare an unsigned BorrowerOperations.claimCollateral() for BTC left in CollSurplusPool after the wallet's trove was redeemed or liquidated

title: Compare holders
description: The largest veBTC or veMEZO holders by locked amount (grouped by owner), what they voted for in the latest epoch, and with measure rewards, what each did with claimed rewards (relocked, swapped, sent, bridged, held)

title: Explain gauge
description: Explain one gauge, validator or pool: this epoch's incentives, current votes, APY, boost and optimal veMEZO, recent epochs, and why it is or isn't in the wallet's optimal ballot

title: Get loan position
description: The selected wallet's mUSD trove: collateral (BTC), debt (principal + accrued interest), collateral ratio vs the 110% minimum, liquidation price, recovery mode, and any claimable collateral surplus

title: Get protocol stats
description: Protocol-wide Mezo Earn totals, never wallet-specific: MEZO locked in veMEZO and BTC locked in veBTC (on chain), veMEZO voting power, number of veMEZO lockers, this epoch's total voting incentives and funded gauge count, the epoch number and when it ends, and the MEZO and BTC reference prices

title: Get wallet context
description: The selected wallet: connected (can sign), watching or inspecting (read only), its veMEZO and veBTC locks and voting power

title: Get wallet earnings
description: The selected wallet's veMEZO voting-incentive earnings: projected this epoch from its standing votes, extrapolated APY on its veMEZO voting power, the last sealed epoch, and what is claimable

title: List claimable rewards
description: Claimable voting rewards for the selected wallet, exact on-chain amounts per lock: boost rewards and cross-chain (MEZO gauge) rewards on veMEZO locks, validator rewards and pool fees and incentives on veBTC locks

title: Mezo knowledge
description: Reviewed Mezo support notes with sources: how veBTC, veMEZO, boost, BoostVoter and ThirdPartyVoter, epochs, voting rules and reverts, claiming, MEZO gauges, MUSD troves, Morpho borrowing, Enclaves, MUSD Savings and gas work, plus safety rules (NFT approvals, relayers)

title: Optimize votes
description: Best personal return: runs the Matchbox reward optimizer for the selected wallet's eligible locks in one voting domain (boost = veMEZO on boost gauges, validators / pools = veBTC) and prepares unsigned ballots

title: Prepare claim
description: Prepare unsigned claim transactions for every lock with claimable rewards (one per lock and voter), exact amounts from earned()

title: Prepare claim relock
description: Claim every claimable reward, then add the claimed MEZO to a veMEZO lock (the named one, else the largest that can take more)

title: Prepare lock action
description: Prepare an unsigned lock action for the selected wallet: add tokens to a lock, extend it (weeks, or null for the maximum), turn on auto max, withdraw an expired lock, merge one lock into another of the same escrow, or transfer a lock to a 0x address

title: Prepare repay
description: Prepare an unsigned mUSD repayment on the selected wallet's trove (BorrowerOperations.repayMUSD, burns mUSD, no approval, one signature)

title: Prepare vote
description: A ballot the user specified as a list (e.g. '30% to Boar, 70% to ChooseMe')

title: Prepare vote script
description: A pasted vote script or governance post with 'N% to <gauge>' lines (e.g. '25% to the BTC/MUSD-200 pool, 20% to the MUSD Savings Vault')

title: Prepare zap
description: Prepare an unsigned zap into MUSD Savings (sMUSD): MEZO is swapped to mUSD on the approved Tigris CL route (price-impact cap, exact approvals, min-out) then deposited

title: Quote zap
description: Quote only (no transactions): how much mUSD a MEZO amount buys on the approved route, with price impact and min-out

title: Rank gauges
description: Rank voting targets

title: Resolve entity
description: Find gauges, validators, pools/vaults or the wallet's locks by name, address or #token id

title: Resolve holder
description: Who is behind a label, name, gauge, lock or address: the addresses (with the source of each link), whether they are Safes, and the veBTC and veMEZO locks they own now (ownerOf, never who voted)

title: Scenario liquidation
description: Deterministic BTC price-drop table for the selected wallet's trove on the current snapshot (not a forecast)

title: Search transactions
description: Bridge journeys for the selected wallet that a provider explicitly links to Mezo (Wormhole today)

title: Trace rewards
description: Follow the money: the rewards an address or entity claimed over a period (incentives, fees, rebases, per token with tx links) and what happened to each claimed token afterwards (locked, swapped, sent and to whom, bridged out, deposited, or still held), with the attribution method
